Name: Mountain

Params.Name: NoiseAlgorithm
Params.Label: Noise Algorithm
Params.Description: Chooses the noise that shapes the mountain's main ridges, shoulders, and valleys.

Params.Name: NoiseScale
Params.Label: Noise Scale
Params.Description: Sets the spacing of mountain ridges and the size of their surface breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values create more closely spaced mountain features.

Params.Name: NoiseSeed
Params.Label: Noise Seed
Params.Description: Rearranges mountain ridges and valleys while preserving their overall scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use a new seed for a different mountain arrangement.

Params.Name: NoiseWarp
Params.Label: Noise Warp
Params.Description: Bends mountain ridges and valleys into less regular paths.
Params.Tooltip: Increase it for more natural, winding mountain structure.

Params.Name: NoiseJitter
Params.Label: Noise Jitter
Params.Description: Offsets cellular feature points in mountain ridge breakup.
Params.Tooltip: Only affects Gabor, Voronoi, and Worley; it changes local ridge detail placement.

Params.Name: Strength
Params.Description: Scales the overall height amplitude of the generated shape.
Params.Tooltip: Adjust the overall strength of this base shape.

Params.Name: Scale
Params.Description: Controls the scale of the coordinate space used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: Higher values generally create smaller, more frequent features.

Params.Name: Levels
Params.Description: Controls the number of recursive detail levels used by the shape.
Params.Tooltip: More levels add detail and increase generation cost.

Params.Name: Seed
Params.Description: Selects the deterministic random pattern used by the generator.
Params.Tooltip: Change the seed to create a different reproducible layout.

Params.Name: Offset
Params.Description: Translates the sampling coordinates without changing the shape's scale.
Params.Tooltip: Use the offset to move through the procedural field.

Params.Name: DampingFactor
Params.Label: Damping Factor
Params.Description: Controls how quickly successive mountain detail is damped.
Params.Tooltip: Higher damping reduces the contribution of later detail.

Description: Generates a mountain-style procedural base shape with controls for its main form and variation.
